name: command-menu-item
title: Command Menu Item
description: An Operator Black command-row specimen with technical shortcuts and restrained selection state.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Comma-separated row labels matched to rows by position. Blank entries keep the authored label.

variables.label: Hover row
variables.description: Which row carries the hover state, counting from 1. Out-of-range values clamp.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent token behind the check icon and the focus ring.

variables.label: Theme
variables.description: Token set for the rows: dark surfaces or light ones.
